rows.traditional: A 同 B 冇關係
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B mou5 gwaan1 hai6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to say that one matter has no bearing on another; Cantonese usually expresses the idea as a clause rather than an abstract noun.

example.english: This matter has nothing to do with the report, so don't bring up this irrelevancy again.
example.traditional: 呢件事同份報告冇關係，唔好再講喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 si6 tung4 fan6 bou3 gou3 mou5 gwaan1 hai6 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for an irrelevant thing or piece of information, rather than for the general quality of lacking relevance.

example.english: That thing you mentioned just now is an irrelevancy, so you can ignore it.
example.traditional: 你頭先講嗰樣係唔關事嘅嘢，唔使理喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 tau4 sin1 gong2 go2 joeng2 hai6 m4 gwaan1 si6 ge3 je5 m4 sai2 lei5 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for an irrelevant aside or remark that goes beyond the topic under discussion.

example.english: This remark is an irrelevancy, so you can ignore it.
example.traditional: 呢句係題外話，你哋可以唔使理。
example.jyutping: nei5 geoi3 hai6 tai4 ngoi6 waa6 nei5 dei6 ho2 ji5 m4 sai2 lei5
